source_verification.claim: Barttin regulates ClC-Ka/ClC-Kb channels; renal dysfunction causes salt wasting and inner-ear dysfunction causes hearing loss.
BSND encodes an essential beta subunit for CLC chloride channels in renal tubules and inner ear; record updated July 23, 2026.

second_answer_attack.strongest_alternative: SLC12A1/NKCC2 or KCNJ1/ROMK defects causing antenatal Bartter syndrome.
second_answer_attack.resolution: Types I and II explain antenatal salt wasting and alkalosis but not the defining congenital sensorineural hearing loss. Biallelic BSND plus deafness specifically points to barttin-dependent ClC-Ka/ClC-Kb dysfunction in kidney and inner ear. ENaC loss has hyperkalemic acidosis, and SLC12A3 causes Gitelman syndrome.
